# Orders Service

This service owns the order lifecycle. It exposes a small REST API and writes
to Postgres. Deployment is handled by the platform team; see the runbook for
rollback. Tests run with `./mvnw verify` and require a local Postgres.

## Support policy

Support agents may read an order but must never change a refund. Refunds require the order owner to confirm in the app. Agents should never ask a customer for a full card number; the app shows only the last four digits.
